svg.title: Dead Reckoning: Nautical plotting sheet
svg.desc: Dead Reckoning (1D): a navigation puzzle on a plotting sheet. From the last fix, Alexi has pencilled two legs by heading, speed and time, and drawn each hour's tide vector from the tide table; one vector, stirred, is turned aside in green to clear the rocks. The dividers mark the dead-reckoned position just inside the target circle, ready to commit.
